items.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Generate a polished high-fidelity portrait mobile web app concept screen, no device hardware, for VibeScroll Library with MANY insights, not a sparse toy graph. This is a new layout study in an established style: cool white background, navy precise sans-serif typography, restrained teal selection, yellow center Save, crisp thin outline icons, subtle card borders, 12px corners, compact well-balanced spacing. Mobile CSS equivalent 390x844, render at high resolution. Very readable text. No giant title or marketing prose.
Top compact VibeScroll wordmark with small yellow scroll symbol and search icon. Heading Library. Two small scope controls Personal / Business, Business active. They are the virtual top roots; show a clear downward ancestry from Business.
Main content is a vertically scrolling OUTLINE TREE, not a horizontal branching canvas. Thin vertical connector spine and small indent, preserve almost full width for cards. Product expanded, under it Customer experience expanded. Show five compact INSIGHT rows, EACH with a different meaningful thin line icon inside a 30px muted-color square, title on one or two lines, short secondary source label and a tiny source glyph. Titles: "Show one clear next step" with compass icon, "Ask fewer questions at signup" with checklist icon, "Explain value before setup" with lightbulb icon, "Measure the first useful action" with gauge icon, "Let users skip optional setup" with sliders icon. Source labels "Product notes", "Design interview", "Workshop notes", "Analytics guide", "UX notebook". No long paragraphs, giant images or repeated Insight badges. Each row 60–72 CSS px, not squeezed illegibly. First row selected with teal left marker, one small secondary badge "1 proposal" not a full duplicated proposal card.
After the five insight rows, quiet full-width "Show more insights" button, then collapsed Pricing, Marketing, Operations category rows with chevrons and folder/category icons; a little next content is visibly continuing downward, do not fit everything into a fake finite canvas. Root and category hit areas comfortably large. Compact sticky header; native vertical scroll indicator, content doesn't overlap navigation. Small unobtrusive "Concept · sample content" caption.
Fixed bottom bar EXACTLY FIVE labeled controls in this exact order Home, Library active, Save, Projects, Account. Save yellow centered circular plus with visible label, two controls either side. Good safe area. No horizontal scroll, no panning/zoom toolbar, no sixth destination, no bouncing or motion blur, no fictional production totals. This static concept should demonstrate a scalable, icon-led library and efficient use of screen space.

Use case: ui-mockup edit refinement. Edit the supplied VibeScroll mobile Library concept. Preserve the cool white/navy/teal/yellow style, icon-led insight rows and EXACT five bottom controls Home, Library active, Save, Projects, Account. Preserve readable type and comfortable touch targets. One specific improvement: REMOVE the redundant full-width Business folder row immediately beneath the Personal/Business root controls. The active Business root control already shows that root. Start the vertical outline directly at Product, then Customer experience. Reduce the tree indent to about 20 CSSpx maximum so cards have more usable width. Use the recovered vertical space to show one additional compact insight row "Keep empty states useful", layout icon, source "Interface study", alongside the existing five insight rows. Keep first insight's 1 proposal badge. Preserve Show more insights and collapsed Pricing, Marketing, Operations with clear chevrons below. No duplicate Business card, no new toolbar, no brand change, no altered bottom navigation, no extra long explanatory text. Content continues vertically, use an ordinary scroll indicator. Small "Concept · sample content" caption. This is a high fidelity concept, not real production data.

Use case: ui-mockup. A polished high-fidelity portrait mobile web app screenshot CONCEPT for VibeScroll Library, no phone frame. Show a second, more space-efficient approach for a large library: a focused category with a compact sticky ancestor path rather than repeated tall parent cards. Consistent cool white surface, dark navy sans text, restrained teal, small muted color squares containing coherent outline icons, yellow center Save. CSS-equivalent 390x844 portrait, generous legible text and comfortable 44px hit targets but compact information. No marketing prose.
Top short VibeScroll wordmark with scroll symbol, search icon. Heading Library alongside small overview icon button labeled Overview. Compact Personal / Business segmented roots, Business active. Immediately below one single breadcrumb line "Business › Product", then bold category heading "Customer experience" with folder icon and small chevron. No duplicate Business or Product card and no three giant parent rows.
Content is one continuous vertically scrollable full-width list with small 8px gaps, no nested scrollboxes, no horizontal carousel. Seven compact rounded insight rows, each a small line icon in a 28px pastel square LEFT, readable title center, short source label below, chevron RIGHT. 1 "Show one clear next step", compass icon, "Product notes", selected subtle teal with small "1 proposal" badge. 2 "Ask fewer signup questions", checklist icon, "Design interview". 3 "Explain value before setup", lightbulb icon, "Workshop notes". 4 "Measure the first useful action", gauge icon, "Analytics guide". 5 "Make optional steps skippable", sliders icon, "UX notebook". 6 "Keep empty states useful", layout icon, "Interface study". 7 "Return users to their last place", bookmark icon, "Product journal". Compact two-line structure, no large thumbnails, no repeated Insight badges, no giant summary paragraphs. The seventh row can partially continue below fold, clearly more content is scrollable. A subtle thin left category spine connects the rows. Below list preview show "Show more" at the lower scroll edge if room, don't squeeze all artificially.
A small outlined button under category header "Related categories" opens compact category navigation, no permanent crowded filter strip. Source details are opened by selecting a row, not all expanded here. Native subtle scrollbar.
Fixed bottom navigation EXACTLY Home, Library active, Save, Projects, Account in that order. Save centered yellow circle with plus, visible Save label, safe area. Small footer "Concept · sample content". No sixth item, no sideways swipe dependency, no global totals, no fabricated completed work. This demonstrates the SAME hierarchy as the overview but deeper focused browsing with more visible insight cards and much less wasted space.

Use case: ui-mockup. Wide high fidelity DESKTOP web app screenshot concept for VibeScroll Library showing how a mature library with MANY categories and insight cards scales. No computer hardware frame. Matching earlier cool-white/teal/yellow design, but in a refined DEVICE DARK MODE: deep navy background, charcoal blue panels, light readable sans text, subtle borders, desaturated pastel icon tiles, restrained teal selection, yellow Save. Precise compact layout, realistic desktop aspect about 16:10. No giant titles or descriptions, no gradient hero.
Leftmost slim app rail: small scroll logo, Home, Library selected, Projects, Account, prominent yellow Save button. Only these destinations. Next column about 240px is a vertical CATEGORY OUTLINE with heading Library, compact Personal / Business controls at TOP, Business selected. Under them Product expanded, subcategory Customer experience selected, Pricing, Research; Marketing expanded with Content, Acquisition, Brand; Operations, Sales, People, Finance collapsed. Fine downward branch connectors, small folder/category icons, chevrons; no repeated Business node below controls. A Search categories control, no fictitious total counters. Category outline is navigable vertically, not spread into a horizontal canvas.
Central flexible column heading "Customer experience", breadcrumb "Business › Product", small search field "Find an insight" and compact sort button "Newest". Show TEN compact but attractive insight cards in a TWO COLUMN GRID, row-major reading order, all with small colored outline icon tile, short title (max two lines) and one muted source line. Titles: "Show one clear next step" compass / Product notes; "Ask fewer signup questions" checklist / Design interview; "Explain value before setup" lightbulb / Workshop notes; "Measure the first useful action" gauge / Analytics guide; "Make optional steps skippable" sliders / UX notebook; "Keep empty states useful" layout / Interface study; "Return users to their last place" bookmark / Product journal; "Make errors actionable" alert / UX notebook; "Use clear progress signals" flag / Product notes; "Keep evidence one tap away" book / Design interview. FIRST card selected teal outline, small "1 proposal" badge. Others no repeated badges, no giant cover images, no paragraphs. Quiet Show more control below; bottom cards continue naturally down screen, subtle native vertical scrollbar, no load-everything claim. These cards approximately 100 CSSpx tall and broad enough to read.
Right column about 320px shows ONLY SELECTED insight detail, titled "Show one clear next step", a short sample claim "Give new users one useful action before optional setup.", source card "Product notes" with View source button. Beneath, a fine vertical arrow label "Used in proposal" connecting to small proposal card "Simplify onboarding", "Demo shop", "To review", button "Review proposal". No uncreated plan shown completed, no execute button, no billing amounts. Right detail context more information, central cards remain compact. Do not show all proposal edges across the category tree.
Small bottom caption "Concept · sample content". Clearly recognizable scalable vertical taxonomy left, compact icon-led insight grid middle, evidence/project link right. Beautiful restrained spacing, comfortable type, alignment exact, no horizontal clipping, no giant blank area, no charts or unverified production statistics.
